usageNotes: Use this to get a typed, dashboard-ready snapshot of a Ceph cluster's health, capacity, OSD/MON/MGR/PG counts, and client I/O rates — the cluster must already be registered in PDM and at least one member must be reachable for the enriched fields (fullest-pool, version) to be populated. Most data is served from PDM's cache; pass `max-age` to control staleness tolerance, and expect `fullest-pool` / `version` to be absent if no live member read succeeds.

examples.summary: Fetch a fresh Ceph cluster summary, accepting cache up to 30 seconds old

tips: The `cluster` path param is the Ceph fsid (UUID format) — find it via the cluster list endpoint, not the cluster's display name.
Check `version-mixed: true` during rolling upgrades; a mixed-version cluster may show degraded performance or unexpected warnings.
If `checks` is non-empty, inspect each entry's `code` (e.g. OSD_DOWN, POOL_NEAR_FULL) to triage alerts without shelling into a Ceph node.
Use `fullest-pool` + `fullest-pool-used` together — cluster-wide `bytes-avail` can look healthy while a single pool is near capacity and blocking writes.
A missing `version` field means no live member read succeeded; the cached health/capacity figures are still returned from PDM's internal cache.
